//: Shared contract for slugify. Asserted from all THREE implementations: scripts/lib/slug.test.mjs (JS), cms/src/types/slug.test.ts (TypeScript) and functions/src/bundle.test.ts (Cloud Functions, which derives a town's bundle id from its name). If the two implementations ever disagree, the importer stops recognising existing destinations and duplicates the province instead of updating it — so this file is the thing that stops that happening quietly.

cases.//: The reason diacritics are stripped rather than dropped.
cases.name: Peñablanca
Basílica Minore de Nuestra Señora de Piat

cases.//: Hyphens already in the name survive; they do not double up.
cases.name: Lal-lo

cases.//: Punctuation collapses to a single separator.
cases.name: St. Peter Metropolitan Cathedral

cases.//: Leading and trailing separators are trimmed, not left dangling.
cases.name: Palaui Island

cases.//: Capped at 60 characters. A slug is a deep-link segment, not prose.
cases.name: The Very Long Name Of A Destination That Runs Past The Sixty Character Cap
